connector.name: QR Rápido
connector.registryDescription: Generate QR codes for URLs, PIX, Wi-Fi, vCards, WhatsApp and more. For AI agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at qrrapido.site over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace site.qrrapido. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
